description: Ultraluxe Designs is the portfolio of Iskandar Norkulov, a graphic and UI/UX designer in Tashkent, Uzbekistan: graphic design, brand identity, logos, interfaces, social media design and 3D.
heroPlain: Graphic design, brand identities, interfaces and social media.
intro: Ultraluxe Designs is the studio of Iskandar Norkulov, a graphic and UI/UX designer in Tashkent working with companies in Uzbekistan and abroad.
services: Print and digital graphics: banners, presentations, merch and packaging.
Logotypes, brand books and full identity systems. A logo can also be ordered on its own.
Interfaces for websites, web applications, dashboards and mobile apps.
Post and story templates, YouTube thumbnails, profile covers and icons.
Retouching, colour correction, noise removal, AI enhancement and upscaling.
Photo manipulation, background removal and composites.
Logo animation, motion graphics and 3D models rendered in Blender.
about: Hello, I'm Iskandar. I'm a graphic designer: I design brands, interfaces and social media for businesses that want to look as good as they are.

I've worked with clients in Uzbekistan, the UK, Germany, Austria, Turkey and Russia, from a yarn store in Berlin to an investment company in the UK. Since 2023 I've also designed every Instagram graphic for Inter Nation English School.
